text: F13.4b: a repeating key on a table built from any dictionary word, solved from the carved letters alone.
Every one of 2,080,620 tables screened column by column by letter counts at every length, the 50 best per length climbed; K4 against 100 shuffles.
K4 sits inside its shuffles (p 0.6634). Planted messages are found only to length 5: 1-5 closed without the known letters, 6-26 too short to decide this way.
